In technology, Qualcomm intensified competition with Nvidia by launching new AI data center chips, while cryptocurrency markets weakened with Bitcoin falling below $60,000. Meanwhile, expectations of prolonged higher interest rates are supporting the dollar while pressuring gold prices, reflecting broader uncertainty about Federal Reserve policy direction.
